name: CPC UWindsor
description: The University of Windsor's competitive programming club. Learn algorithms, practise weekly, compete in contests, and train for the ICPC East Central NA Regional.

home.headline: Learn algorithms. Compete. Go to ICPC.
home.pitch: CPC UWindsor is a student club for anyone who wants to get better at solving problems with code. We run weekly practice sessions, club contests and workshops, and we train UWindsor teams for the ICPC East Central North America Regional, which UWindsor hosts. No experience needed: if you can write a loop, you can start.

highlights.title: Weekly practice
highlights.text: Practice nights and workshops on the core ideas: sorting, binary search, graphs, dynamic programming. Every session comes with problems to try on the spot, and beginners are welcome.

highlights.title: Club contests
highlights.text: A timed contest on Kattis every month, solo or in teams, with a live scoreboard. Every past contest stays open, so you can practise the problems you missed.

highlights.title: ICPC teams
highlights.text: We form teams of three and train them for the ICPC East Central NA Regional, which is hosted right here at UWindsor.
